title: scopedVerify
responsibility: Runs the scenarios covering one entity, reports screenshot attachment status, narrows entity-scoped impact, and configures the verification environment.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.context
inputs.description: The source verification context, including repository root, commit/tree revisions, base/head sides, and verify configuration. Its revision-side indexes contain Map values, which JSON examples cannot represent.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.runtime
inputs.description: Execution runtime recorded in the scoped impact report. It must be one of the declared runtime kinds: module, wasm, process, or http.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.options
inputs.description: Verification options passed to the service. This function reads entity and converts a truthy testTimeout with Number; it does not read the other options.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.env
inputs.description: Environment variables forwarded to the verification service and snapshot checks. The supplied record is passed through as given, with each value either a string or undefined.

inputs.name: renderAttachment.attachment
inputs.description: Optional attachment summary from a verification result. An absent value produces no lines; a present value carries an attachment status, entity, record id, states, and viewports.

inputs.name: scopedContext.context
inputs.description: The source verification context whose head side will replace its base side. Its revision-side indexes contain Map values, which JSON examples cannot represent.

inputs.name: scopedImpact.head
inputs.description: Revision string copied into the scoped impact report head field. This helper does not resolve or validate the revision.

inputs.name: scopedImpact.runtime
inputs.description: Execution runtime copied into the scoped impact report. It must be one of the declared runtime kinds: module, wasm, process, or http.

inputs.name: timer.entity
inputs.description: Optional entity identifier used to prefix timing messages. A falsy value suppresses writes, and the identifier is not validated here.

inputs.name: verifyEnv.options
inputs.description: Verification options used to set resource priority and optionally mark entity-scoped checks. Only priority and a truthy entity affect the returned environment.

outputs.name: scopedVerify
outputs.description: Resolves to the stored verification record with an attachment summary. Attachment is skipped unless there is at least one passing test and scenario, all failures are the scoped marker, and a screenshot exists; qualifying proof is attached or unchanged.

failures: Scoped to reports.component.evidence-grid: only its scenario states ran, so this record is partial and never a full pass.

outputs.name: renderAttachment
outputs.description: Returns no lines when attachment is absent, one skipped message for skipped status, or one summary with states, viewports, and record for attached or unchanged status.
examples: No screenshots attached for reports.component.evidence-grid: failed or incomplete run.
Screenshots attached for reports.component.evidence-grid: states reports.state.initial; viewports desktop; record aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.

outputs.name: scopedContext
outputs.description: Shallow copy of the context with base set to the same revision side as head; all other fields are retained. Its revision-side indexes contain Map values, which JSON examples cannot represent.

outputs.name: scopedImpact
outputs.description: Report with base none, the supplied head and runtime, expanded false, and empty changed, unit, test, scenario, and uncertainty lists. It does not compute impact.

outputs.name: timer
outputs.description: Callback that writes [verify <entity>] <step> +<elapsed>ms to stderr when entity is truthy. Elapsed time is measured from callback creation; an absent or empty entity suppresses output.

outputs.name: verifyEnv
outputs.description: Returns a copy of process.env with HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY set from options.priority ?? process.env.HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY ?? 'environment' after enum parsing. It sets HARNESS_VERIFY_ENTITY only when options.entity is truthy.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when no head scenario covers the requested entity; the scoped verification cannot run without a covering scenario.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by resourcePriority.parse when the selected resource priority is not agent-test, coding, or environment.
